messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — saw a tiny but persistent spike in routing failures around 11:42 UTC. Seems tied to clients that still send x-client-version: v1 when we flipped the default. Yellow tape idea: quarantine traffic that looks like old handshake and show a weaker banner instead of hard-fail. Thoughts?
ben: can you paste the error pattern?
alyssa: sure — main pattern is 409 + 'version-mismatch' and then a lot of retries. snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
content-type: application/json
{"error":"version-mismatch","asked_for":"v1","served":"v2"}
```
mira: ugh. that's the one we expected, but the retry loop is killing per-route quota. retries from clients that don't understand 409 -> they backoff too slowly.
ben: if they keep retrying we'll see quota pressure. have we considered returning a 200 with a small compatibility-warning payload for a grace window? not ideal, but reduces retry storms.
sam: that would be a bits-of-sugar approach. But it hides the real incompatibility. maybe instead we should send a 425 or a 410 with a structured header like `x-version-suggest: v2` to be explicit and have the console flag show a yellow tape.
alyssa: exactly — console-banner could show 'yellow tape' for these tokens, with a CTA to docs. If console shows it and telemetry tags requests, we can notify top-10 tenants.
infra-bot: deploy/notice: rollout v2-default on prod-3 at 11:20 UTC. Canary success 99.98%.
mira: @infra-bot thanks. can we add a telemetry tag for 'quarantine' and emit a per-tenant rate? I want to see if it's concentrated.
ben: +1. Also add a short-lived metric: `compat.quarantine.retry_rate` to identify retry loops.
sam: operationally we need an escape hatch. If quarantine causes more reroutes, backpressure might cascade. Circuit-breaker plan: if `compat.quarantine.retry_rate` > 0.5 req/s per route for 5m -> flip quarantine to soft-mode (200+warning) for that route. Manual override from console.
mira: that sounds reasonable. also, we should avoid changing billing semantics. Quarantined requests should still be billed normal, but flagged in logs for partner outreach.
alyssa: timeline proposal: add telemetry tags + banner copy today; enable 'soft-mode' autopilot after 30m if retry spike; outreach to top-10 impacted tomorrow morning.
ben: need UX copy suggestions for banner: short, actionable. my draft: "Heads up — your app is using an older API version (v1). This route is in compatibility quarantine. See how to migrate -> docs.link/migrate-v1-to-v2"
sam: include a small 'simulate v2' toggle? allow devs to opt-in to v2-compat rendering from console to validate before full switch.
mira: love that. But add audit log entry when they simulate.
alyssa: agree. ok next steps: 1) infra: emit `compat.quarantine` tag and metric (ben + infra team) 2) console: yellow-tape banner + simulate toggle + audit (ux + product) 3) ops: implement soft-mode autopilot threshold and manual override (sam) 4) outreach: top-10 tenant list (mira)
ben: i'll create the infra ticket and include example telemetry lines.
sam: i'll draft the circuit-breaker runbook and emergency console toggle flow.
mira: i'll make the outreach list and draft the email template.
alyssa: thanks team. re-check in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
